reported.title: Incorrect LED Pin Assignment
reported.description: The LED is assigned to pin D12 in the sketch, but according to the pin map, it should be on pin D13.

reported.title: Timing Issue with LED State Change
reported.description: The LED state change does not guarantee reaching the commanded state within 100 ms due to the lack of a delay after setting the LED state.

judgement.notes: The second reported bug does not match any truth bug.
